# Bench sink r1: insulation check (generated by scripts/bench_insulation.py; do not edit)

Stress bound tab -> PE sink: 435.7 V (worst die VDS, OPEN-ITEMS S3) + 186.7 V (132 V line peak) = **622.4 V peak**; step 3: <= 600 V DC. Bench floor: basic (creepage 4.0 mm, clearance 1.3 mm, type-test level 1250 Vac).
